profile.headline: Software Engineer V at HX5, LLC

positions.title: Software Engineer V
positions.description:
NASA GEARS Contract Software Branch Manager
* Leading the software engineering team supporting the Glenn Engineering and Research Support (GEARS) contract.
* Ensuring compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements.
* Providing guidance to software developers on best practices throughout the software development life cycle.
* Acting as liaison between government and contract software teams.
* Advising software developers of the GRC Site Availability Toolkit (GSAT) for evaluation of potential lunar landing sites on software regulatory compliance.
* Developing propulsion system models and support tools on the Power and Propulsion Element (PPE) project (Ground Software Lead).
* Improving measurement of tank levels in zero gravity on the Radio Frequency Mass Gauge (RFMG) project (Software Lead).
* Developing reliable internetworking for space missions on the High Rate Delay Tolerant Networking (HDTN) project.
* Maturing Cryogenic Fluid Management (CFM) technologies on the Large Cryofluid Demonstration (LCD) and Integrated Flight Demonstration (IFD) projects.
* Developing on-board plasma diagnostics on the Plasma Diagnostics Package (PDP) project (Software Lead).
* Supporting improvement of solar electric propulsion for deep space exploration on the Advanced Electric Propulsion System (AEPS) project.
* Creating and executing Software Development Plans.
* Generating software project life cycle cost estimates.
* Creating and maintaining software project schedules.
* Implementing and maintaining software configuration management.
* Performing software requirements analysis.
* Designing, documenting, and implementing flight software architecture.
* Testing, debugging, and providing software support for embedded controllers
* Authoring software requirements, design, and test documents
* Working in ISO 9001 and NPR 7150.2 regulated environment.
* Providing oversight on NASA subcontractor compliance and flight software engineering and development.

positions.title: Software Engineer V
positions.description:
NASA GESS-3 Contract
* Supporting effort to improve solar electric propulsion for deep space exploration on the Advanced Electric Propulsion System (AEPS) project. 
* Plasma Diagnostics Package Software Lead.
* Writing software verification test procedures for NASA Electric Aircraft Testbed (NEAT).
* Providing oversight on NASA subcontractor CMMI 2 compliance and flight software engineering and development.
* Generating software project life cycle cost estimates.
* Performing software requirements analysis and implementing requirements in design.
* Designing, documenting, and implementing flight software architecture.
* Authoring requirements, design and test documents
* Testing, debugging, and providing software support for embedded controllers
* Working in ISO 9001 and NPR 7150.2 regulated environment.

positions.description:

* Supporting effort to improve solar electric propulsion for deep space exploration on the Advanced Electric Propulsion System (AEPS) project at NASA Glenn Research Center. 
* Acting Plasma Diagnostics Package Software Lead.
* Providing oversight on NASA subcontractor CMMI 2 compliance and flight software engineering and development.
* Generating software project life cycle cost estimates.
* Performing software requirements analysis and implementing requirements in design.

* Authoring requirements, design and test documents

* Working in ISO 9001 and NPR 7150.2 regulated environment.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Engineer III
positions.description:
(Contract)
* Writing assessments, requirements, plans, protocols, and test reports for computer system validation.
* Working in FDA/ISO 13485, IEC 60601 regulated environment.

positions.title: Senior Quality Engineer
positions.description:
(Contract)
* Writing system and subsystem verification test cases for client.
* Working in FDA/ISO 13485, IEC 60601 regulated environment.

positions.title: System Test Engineer
positions.description:
(Contract)
* Writing and executing protocols designed to test control device and stimulation generator interactions.
* Documenting bugs and verifying bug fixes.
* Formal system level device verification testing.
* Hardware unit level regression testing.
* Software regression testing.
* Preparation for FDA Premarket Approval submission.
* Working in FDA/ISO 13485, IEC 60601 regulated environment.

company.name: Lockheed Martin Global Training and Logistics

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
F-35 Joint Strike Fighter System Development and Demonstration – Training Devices
Responsibilities:
* Development of infrastructure software for F-35 Training Devices.
* Formal Test and Validation of F-35 Full Mission Simulator Training Device.
* Rehosting Mission Systems Operational Flight Programs for the Training Devices hardware platform.
* Restructuring MS OFP integration process and award fee tracking.
* Creating, maintaining, and performing hardware/software integration tests.
* Special projects.
* Working in AS9100 regulated environment.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
F-35 Joint Strike Fighter System Development and Demonstration – Flight Critical Redundancy Management & Initiated Built-In Test
Responsibilities:
* Developing and maintaining software requirements and design for System Integrity Management and Initiated Built-In Test software.
* Creating, maintaining, and performing hardware/software integration tests.
* Developing and maintaining decoder tools for Flight Controls Initiated Built-In Test and Fault History record structures.
* Point of contact for all Vehicle Systems/Mission Systems interface issues.
* Creating formal tests for Mission Systems Pilot System software.
* Developing and instructing Hardware/Software Integration classes for new employees.
* Mapping C-5 AMP autopilot ICD (special assignment)
* Working in AS9100 regulated environment.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
T-50 Supersonic Trainer Aircraft – Flight Control Systems
Responsibilities:
* Developing and maintaining software requirements and design for Flight Control System software.
* Creating, maintaining, and performing hardware/software integration tests.
* Assisting with development of formal verification tests.
* Aiding in refinement of aircraft avionics models.
* Working in AS9100 regulated environment.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
X-35 Joint Strike Fighter Concept Demonstration Aircraft – Vehicle Management Systems
Responsibilities:
* Developing and maintaining software requirements and design for vehicle management software.
* Creating, maintaining, and performing hardware/software integration tests.
* Creating and performing formal software tests.
* Operating and piloting flying qualities visual cockpit simulations.
* Providing on-site flight test support for issues related to vehicle management software.
* Providing overnight turn-arounds on all VMS related aircraft issues during flight test.
* Creating displays for real-time data acquisition during flight testing.
* Working in AS9100 regulated environment.

positions.title: Avionics Service Center Technical Support Intern
positions.description: Writing technical procedures used to modify and convert avionics equipment.
